description: Store a report text written by the Analyse-Agent: art (taeglich|woechentlich|monatlich|jaehrlich, or zeitraum with zeitraum {von, bis}), ebene (default alle), inhalt_md (Markdown), kurzfassung (at most three sentences, for WhatsApp), modell (your model name). The server rebuilds the numbers and checks EVERY number in both texts against them (rounding, percent and Swiss formatting allowed; evidence ids only in `code`). Unknown numbers → nothing stored, returns unbekannte_zahlen to fix. A report due today for its standard period is stored as the day's report (once; never overwritten) and then sent per the tenant's settings. The Analyse-Agent, admins and planners.

art.description: Report period, or zeitraum for a custom period

kurzfassung.description: Short version, at most three sentences, for WhatsApp

zeitraum.description: Custom period {von, bis} (YYYY-MM-DD) when art is zeitraum

name: save_agent_bericht
